source: I need an town you can ragdoll and you spawn with a rocket launcher and a sword to ragdoll people make sure its 3D not 2D

image_prompt.text: Ragdoll-friendly props through the town - stacked crates, benches, street lamps, light debris that flies when a rocket lands
A dangerous region somewhere in the town for physics to throw people into
Streets and alleys threading the town so players can chase each other and line up shots
a town of small buildings - shops and houses - around a central square, with open ground and alleys between them

layout_placement.text: players spawn already carrying a rocket launcher and a sword

notes: Roblox files ragdoll games under Physics Sim, which is the preset here. The weapons make it read partly as Action, but the stated point is the ragdoll reaction rather than a fight with a win condition, so the shared physics world was kept.
Nothing in the handoff carries the starting loadout; it is written as free text in the layout stream so it survives.

open_questions.ask: What should the town look like - modern suburb, old-town stone, cartoon blocky?
A few streets you can cross in seconds, or a proper town to roam?
Is there any scoring or objective, or is it a free-for-all physics playground?

coverage_missing.ask: How large should the town be?
Any scoring, rounds or objectives, or purely a sandbox?
Are the buildings enterable, or facades only? That is a real cost difference.

answers.ask: What should the town look like - modern suburb, old-town stone, cartoon blocky?
answers.answer: Make it a cartoon blocky 3D town to match the ragdoll gameplay.

answers.ask: A few streets you can cross in seconds, or a proper town to roam?
answers.answer: Use a few streets that players can cross in seconds so it stays small and playable.

answers.ask: Is there any scoring or objective, or is it a free-for-all physics playground?
answers.answer: It is a free-for-all physics playground with no scoring or objective.
